summary: Four people (John Buschmann, 28; Derek Howe, 26; Byron Diamond, 25, all of Buena Vista, and Brittany Nipert of Glendale) and two dogs stranded above the Mount Princeton trailhead after a snowslide blocked their descent route; they spent Saturday night in a Forest Service backcountry chalet and called for help Sunday morning; found uninjured at ~4:45 p.m. Sunday and returned to the trailhead 1.5 hours later via snowmobiles and snowcats
responding_agency: Chaffee County SAR North & South, Chaffee County Sheriff's Office, Heart of the Rockies Snowmobile Club
notes: 16 rescuers; ~5.5-hour operation. Incident date pinned to 2013-01-27 (Sunday): article text says rescue Sunday afternoon with press release Monday; article UUID creation timestamp 2013-01-29 UTC (Mountain Mail publish next-day convention). Recorded at rescue-conclusion date per convention.
